SAGE      = '#2d6a4f'
SAGE_LT   = '#6ba88a'
GOLD      = '#b8860b'
GOLD_LT    = '#d4a73a'
SLATE     = '#475569'
GRID      = '#e0d8d0'
TEXT      = '#1a1a1a'
TEXT_DIM  = '#5c5c5c'
RED_MK    = '#b91c1c'
GREEN_MK  = '#15803d'
BLUE_MK   = '#1d4ed8'
GRAY_MK   = '#9ca3af'

# ── Global matplotlib style ───────────────────────────────────────────────
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Liberation Serif', 'FreeSerif', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 9.5,
    'axes.titlesize': 11.5,
    'axes.labelsize': 9.5,
    'text.color': TEXT,
    'axes.edgecolor': TEXT_DIM,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT,
    'xtick.color': TEXT_DIM,
    'ytick.color': TEXT_DIM,
    'grid.color': GRID,
    'grid.alpha': 0.7,
    'grid.linewidth': 0.5,
    'figure.facecolor': CREAM,
    'axes.facecolor': CREAM,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'legend.frameon': False,
    'legend.fontsize': 8.5,
    'legend.title_fontsize': 9,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11.5, 14.5), facecolor=CREAM)

# ── Panel layout using GridSpec ───────────────────────────────────────────
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 1, hspace=0.55, top=0.955, bottom=0.03,
                       left=0.09, right=0.97)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])

# Panel labels
for ax, label in zip([ax1, ax2, ax3], ['A', 'B', 'C']):
    ax.text(-0.07, 1.02, label, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=14,
            fontweight='bold', color=NAVY, va='bottom', ha='left',
            fontfamily='serif')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL A: Tariff Escalation Timeline
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

periods_str = [d['period'] for d in tariff]
us_tariff   = np.array([d['us_tariff_on_china'] for d in tariff])
cn_tariff   = np.array([d['china_tariff_on_us'] for d in tariff])
x_tariff    = np.arange(len(periods_str))

# Fill the gap between China and US tariff lines to emphasize divergence
ax1.fill_between(x_tariff, us_tariff, cn_tariff, alpha=0.06, color=SLATE,
                 zorder=1)

# Main tariff lines
ax1.plot(x_tariff, us_tariff, color=NAVY, linewidth=2.4, marker='o',
         markersize=5.5, markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=2.0,
         markeredgecolor=NAVY, label='U.S. tariff on Chinese goods',
         zorder=5, clip_on=False)
ax1.plot(x_tariff, cn_tariff, color=TERRA, linewidth=2.4, marker='s',
         markersize=5.5, markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=2.0,
         markeredgecolor=TERRA, label='China tariff on U.S. goods',
         zorder=5, clip_on=False)

# ── Policy event markers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
event_period_map = {
    '2017-H1': 0, '2017-H2': 1, '2018-H1': 2, '2018-H2': 3,
    '2019-H1': 4, '2019-H2': 5, '2020-H1': 6, '2020-H2': 7,
    '2021-H1': 8, '2021-H2': 9, '2022-H1': 10, '2022-H2': 11,
    '2023-H1': 12, '2023-H2': 13, '2024-H1': 14,
}

cat_colors = {'investigation': BLUE_MK, 'tariff': RED_MK,
              'deal': GREEN_MK, 'review': GRAY_MK}
cat_styles = {'investigation': 'dashdot', 'tariff': 'dotted',
              'deal': 'dashed', 'review': (0, (3, 3))}
cat_labels = {'investigation': 'Investigation', 'tariff': 'Tariff action',
              'deal': 'Trade deal', 'review': 'Policy review'}

# Key events to label prominently
KEY_EVENTS = [
    'Section 301 Investigation Initiated',
    'List 1: 25% tariff on $34B Chinese goods',
    'List 3: 10% tariff on $200B Chinese goods',
    'List 3 raised to 25% on $200B Chinese goods',
    'Phase One Trade Deal Signed',
    'Biden raises tariffs on EVs (100%), semiconductors (50%), solar cells, steel',
]

drawn_cats = set()
event_positions = []  # (xpos, event_dict) for all events

for ev in events:
    base = event_period_map.get(ev['period_approx'], 0)
    d = datetime.strptime(ev['date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
    month = d.month
    if month <= 6:
        frac = (month - 1) / 6.0
    else:
        frac = (month - 7) / 6.0
    xpos = base + frac
    event_positions.append((xpos, ev))

    cat = ev['category']
    color = cat_colors.get(cat, GRAY_MK)
    style = cat_styles.get(cat, 'dotted')

    lbl = cat_labels.get(cat, '') if cat not in drawn_cats else None
    drawn_cats.add(cat)

    # Vertical dashed line for all events
    ax1.axvline(x=xpos, color=color, linestyle=style, linewidth=0.9,
                alpha=0.7, label=lbl, zorder=2)

# ── Label key events with staggered text annotations ──────────────────────
# Sort key events by x position
key_events_sorted = []
for xpos, ev in event_positions:
    if ev['event'] in KEY_EVENTS:
        key_events_sorted.append((xpos, ev))

# Stagger labels: alternating between upper band (y ~27-29) and lower band (y ~23-25)
# to avoid overlapping text
used_slots = []  # (xmin, xmax, y) occupied regions

for i, (xpos, ev) in enumerate(key_events_sorted):
    cat = ev['category']
    color = cat_colors.get(cat, GRAY_MK)

    # Shorten label text
    short = ev['event']
    if 'Biden raises tariffs on EVs' in short:
        short = 'Biden raises tariffs\n(EVs 100%, semiconductors 50%)'
    elif 'List 3 raised to 25%' in short:
        short = 'List 3 raised to 25%\non $200B goods'
    elif 'List 1: 25% tariff' in short:
        short = 'List 1: 25% on $34B'
    elif 'List 3: 10% tariff' in short:
        short = 'List 3: 10% on $200B'
    elif 'Phase One' in short:
        short = 'Phase One Deal\nSigned'
    elif 'Section 301 Investigation' in short:
        short = 'Section 301\nInvestigation'

    # Stagger vertically to avoid label overlap
    if i % 2 == 0:
        text_y = 27.5
        line_end_y = 25.5
    else:
        text_y = 23.5
        line_end_y = 21.5

    # Place text annotation with a thin connector line
    ax1.annotate(short,
                 xy=(xpos, line_end_y),
                 xytext=(xpos, text_y),
                 fontsize=7.2, color=color, fontweight='bold',
                 ha='center', va='bottom', fontfamily='serif',
                 arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=color, lw=0.6,
                                 connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0'),
                 zorder=10)

# Add a light horizontal band indicator for the tariff war phases
ax1.axvspan(-0.4, 1.9, alpha=0.04, color=GRAY_MK, zorder=0)
ax1.text(0.75, 29.2, 'Pre-tariff', fontsize=7.5, color=TEXT_DIM,
         ha='center', fontstyle='italic', fontfamily='serif')

ax1.axvspan(1.9, 5.5, alpha=0.04, color=RED_MK, zorder=0)
ax1.text(3.7, 29.2, 'Escalation phase', fontsize=7.5, color=RED_MK,
         ha='center', fontstyle='italic', fontfamily='serif',
         fontweight='bold')

ax1.axvspan(5.5, 13.6, alpha=0.04, color=GRAY_MK, zorder=0)
ax1.text(9.55, 29.2, 'Plateau / partial relief', fontsize=7.5, color=TEXT_DIM,
         ha='center', fontstyle='italic', fontfamily='serif')

ax1.axvspan(13.6, 14.4, alpha=0.04, color=RED_MK, zorder=0)
ax1.text(14.0, 29.2, 'New tariffs', fontsize=7.5, color=RED_MK,
         ha='center', fontstyle='italic', fontfamily='serif',
         fontweight='bold')

ax1.set_xlim(-0.4, 14.4)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 31)
ax1.set_ylabel('Average effective tariff rate (%)')
ax1.set_yticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30])

# X-axis labels: show all half-year periods
tick_labels_show = []
for p in periods_str:
    tick_labels_show.append(p.replace('-', ' '))
ax1.set_xticks(x_tariff)
ax1.set_xticklabels(tick_labels_show, fontsize=6.5, rotation=35, ha='right')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', which='both', pad=2)

ax1.set_title('U.S.–China Tariff Escalation and Key Policy Events',
              fontweight='bold', color=NAVY, pad=10, fontsize=11.5)

leg1 = ax1.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=7.8, ncol=2,
                  handlelength=2.0, handletextpad=0.6, columnspacing=1.2)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.4, linewidth=0.5)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PANEL B: Bilateral Trade Volume
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

years_trade = np.array([d['year'] for d in trade])
exports     = np.array([d['us_exports_to_china'] for d in trade])
imports_val = np.array([d['us_imports_from_china'] for d in trade])
total_bilat = np.array([d['total_bilateral'] for d in trade])

bar_w = 0.55

# Stacked bars: exports on bottom, imports on top
ax2.bar(years_trade, imports_val, bar_w, bottom=exports, color=NAVY_LT,
        alpha=0.55, label='U.S. imports from China', zorder=3,
        edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.bar(years_trade, exports, bar_w, color=NAVY, alpha=0.9,
        label='U.S. exports to China', zorder=4,
        edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

# Total bilateral line overlaid
ax2.plot(years_trade, total_bilat, color=TERRA, linewidth=2.2, marker='D',
         markersize=6, markerfacecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.6,
         markeredgecolor=TERRA, label='Total bilateral trade', zorder=6)

# Data labels on total line
label_offsets = {2016: -20, 2017: 14, 2018: -20, 2019: -20,
                 2020: 14, 2021: 14, 2022: -20, 2023: 14, 2024: 14}
for yr, val in zip(years_trade, total_bilat):

    ax2.annotate(f'{val:.0f}', (yr, val), textcoords="offset points",

ax2.set_yticks([0, 200, 400, 600, 800])

ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.4, linewidth=0.5)

ax3.annotate(f'Vietnam {vietnam_share[-1]:.1f}%',

# China decline arrow annotation
mid_idx = len(years_supply) // 2
ax3.annotate('',
             xy=(2020, 18.6), xytext=(2017, 21.6),

ax3.text(2018.5, 19.6, 'China share\ndeclining', fontsize=7.5,

raw_arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Verify tariff data
t = data['tariff_rates']['data']
print('=== Tariff Data (first 3 + last 2) ===')
for d in t[:3] + t[-2:]:
    print(f\"  {d['period']}: US={d['us_tariff_on_china']}%, CN={d['china_tariff_on_us']}%\")

# Verify trade data
tr = data['bilateral_trade']['data']
print('\n=== Trade Data (first 2 + last 2) ===')
for d in tr[:2] + tr[-2:]:
    print(f\"  {d['year']}: exports={d['us_exports_to_china']}, imports={d['us_imports_from_china']}, total={d['total_bilateral']}\")
    # Verify total
    assert d['total_bilateral'] == d['us_exports_to_china'] + d['us_imports_from_china'], f'Total mismatch for {d[\"year\"]}'

# Verify supply chain
s = data['supply_chain_share']['data']
print('\n=== Supply Chain Data (first 2 + last 2) ===')
for d in s[:2] + s[-2:]:
    ssum = d['china'] + d['vietnam'] + d['india'] + d['rest_of_world']
    print(f\"  {d['year']}: China={d['china']}%, Vietnam={d['vietnam']}%, India={d['india']}%, Rest={d['rest_of_world']}% (sum={ssum:.1f})\")

# Verify policy events
ev = data['policy_events']['data']
print(f'\n=== Policy Events: {len(ev)} events ===')
for e in ev:
    print(f\"  {e['date']} [{e['category']}] {e['event']}\")

print('\n=== All data validated ===')
print(f'Tariff periods: {len(t)}')
print(f'Trade years: {len(tr)}')
print(f'Supply chain years: {len(s)}')
print(f'Policy events: {len(ev)}')
"
